title: Restricted width and blocked width
statement: Let $C$ be a depth circuit and assign to each input coordinate one of three states: free, fixed to $1$, or fixed to $-1$. The maximum restricted width among the first-layer gates is at most five times the maximum blocked restricted width, plus four.
hypotheses_covered: A coordinate restriction assigning each coordinate one of free, fixed to $1$, or fixed to $-1$
